sourceFindings: PRD RF14 covers audit history for changes and state transitions including cancellations; RN07 requires state-change audit and prohibits deleting started reservations. This story addresses only applied schedule changes.

PRD RN10 requires requester submission, Responsible approval, original-time preservation, conflict revalidation, and pending-request expiry. This story intentionally implements only an internal method for applying an already-approved change.
RTM lists RF14 as pending and identifies broader integration and Testcontainers evidence as pending; this story must not change that status to complete.

Reserva persists LocalDateTime inicio/fim, has nullable Responsavel and currently exposes schedule setters. ReservaService already uses a transaction, pessimistic locking, and room-conflict checks, providing an identifiable integration point.
The source pom.xml currently has PostgreSQL runtime and H2 test dependencies but no Flyway or Testcontainers declarations; those dependencies/setup are implementation work, not a draft blocker.
Search found direct schedule assignment in the frontend prototype, but it is in-memory and not a persisted database write; AC7's guarantee must remain limited to persisted application write paths.
Code intelligence was available and reported no duplicate functionality.
No local epic, architecture document, or accumulated-context.md was found. Stories 1.1 and 1.2 were checked for coherence; neither was modified.
